stemMd: A paragraph explains how a neighborhood seed library makes gardening affordable: members borrow seeds, grow plants, and return seeds from the harvest. Which addition most directly develops this focus?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The town was incorporated more than a century ago.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Members can try unfamiliar vegetables without buying an entire packet of seeds.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Several members also collect antique garden tools.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The library building was painted blue last summer.

explanationMd: Identify the paragraph's focus before evaluating the details. Trying vegetables without purchasing packets gives a concrete example of how sharing seeds lowers costs.

distractorRationale.a: Town history is unrelated to the financial benefit.
distractorRationale.d: The paint color does not explain gardening affordability.
distractorRationale.c: A separate collecting hobby does not develop the seed-sharing benefit.
